meta.source: Authored from the ZatcaWeb product brief (no prior brand assets).

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: App canvas behind cards and the page body of the marketing site.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, invoice paper, inputs. The default working surface.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, inset wells, read-only fields, the sidebar in light mode.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs, drawers, command menu (paired with a shadow).

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons on bg-surface and bg-sunken.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, chosen option; carries ink-brand text.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the inverse toast; text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: bg-scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs, drawers and the command menu.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-sunken, bg-raised.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table body cells, labels on every bg-* surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Helper text, captions, placeholders, timestamps on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-sunken, bg-hover.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for information.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse (tooltips, inverse toast).

tokens.name: ink-brand
tokens.usage: Links, active nav label, selected values on bg-surface, bg-canvas and bg-selected.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between table rows and list items; decorative only.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card and panel outlines, section separators; decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and secondary-button borders (3:1 on bg-surface and bg-sunken).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every focusable element (3:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Faint brand wash: hero backdrops, highlighted table rows.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Brand tint fills: selected chips, onboarding checklist done-state.

tokens.name: brand-200
tokens.usage: Brand tint borders and chart area fills.

tokens.name: brand-400
tokens.usage: Chart series 'paid', progress bars, sparklines.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Brand mark tile, icons on brand surfaces, chart series 1.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, checked controls, active tab indicator. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Primary button hover / pressed fill.

tokens.name: brand-900
tokens.usage: Deep brand ground: marketing bands, cover blocks. Text on it is on-brand-deep.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-600 and brand-700 fills.

tokens.name: on-brand-deep
tokens.usage: Text on brand-900 grounds.

tokens.name: accent-100
tokens.usage: Dune tint: recommendation cards, plan highlight, 'new' chips.

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: Dune fill: the logo pixel, chart series 2, upgrade highlights. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Dune text on bg-surface and accent-100 (AI insights, pro features).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-500 fills.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Paid / Accepted / Validation passed badge fill.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on success-bg and bg-surface.

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Success in charts and progress (lightness-separated from danger-fill).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning / Partially paid / Requires action badge fill.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on warning-bg and bg-surface.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Warning in charts and meters (e.g. 80% usage).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Overdue / Rejected / error badge and banner fill.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive labels and icons on danger-bg and bg-surface.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and danger series in charts. Text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-fill.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Pending / Submission pending / Sent badge fill, info banners.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text and icons on info-bg and bg-surface.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Draft / Not validated / Cancelled badge fill.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral badge text on neutral-bg.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: The ZatcaWeb mark's tile. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-glyph
tokens.usage: The Z inside the mark tile. Logo only.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 — revenue, sales, the business's own figures.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2 — comparison period, VAT.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3 — expenses, purchases.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4 — fourth category only.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5 — fifth category. A sixth+ series folds into 'Other' in ink-muted.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axes ticks.

families.sans: "Inter Variable", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Inter Variable", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display-lg

styles.name: h2

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Field-group labels, table group headers.

styles.name: body-lg

styles.usage: Marketing body copy, empty-state descriptions.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Payment due within 30 days of issue.
styles.usage: Default app text: forms, tables, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Customer names, row primaries, button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense tables, helper text, metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, chart labels, timestamps.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: English-only section kickers and KPI labels; never applied to Arabic (Arabic has no case).

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic marketing hero. Arabic needs ~1.35× the Latin leading.

styles.name: ar-h1
styles.usage: Arabic page titles.

styles.name: ar-h2
styles.usage: Arabic card and section titles.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: تستحق الدفعة خلال ٣٠ يومًا من تاريخ الإصدار.
styles.usage: Default Arabic UI text — one step larger than Latin body for equal optical size.

styles.name: ar-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense Arabic tables and helper text.

styles.name: ar-label
styles.usage: Arabic field labels and badges.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: Grand totals and the one headline KPI. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: num-kpi
styles.usage: KPI card values. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: num-table
styles.usage: Amount columns; right-aligned in LTR, left-aligned in RTL.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Invoice numbers, VAT/CR numbers, API keys, hashes, error codes.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Dense accounting tables use space-2/space-3; marketing uses space-12 and up.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: badge icon to text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; table cell vertical padding (dense).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; table cell padding; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gap; form field stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact cards, KPI).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default); gap between dashboard cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; section gap inside a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; onboarding step padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding (desktop).

tokens.usage: Checkboxes, QR modules, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, dropdowns, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, the invoice paper, hero product frames.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Marketing feature panels, mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, pills, switches, status dots.

tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons (secondary).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (paired with border-default).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, toasts, the date picker.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, command menu, the floating AI assistant.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons/inputs in dense tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing CTAs, onboarding and mobile primary actions.

tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.
